links.to_node: The malfunctioning shuttle is disabled and unavailable for service.
The shuttle is not deployed on its scheduled route.
Five elementary school students remain unharmed by the shuttle.
The crossing guard avoids witnessing the shuttle run over the students.
Campus shuttle service on that route is disrupted.
The university lab incurs shuttle damage and repair costs.
I face disciplinary or legal trouble for unauthorized property damage.
